mapper.select: SELECT store_id FROM m_stores ORDER BY store_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO m_stores( store_name, email, tel, postal_code, address, opening_hours, closed_days, store_status, note, created_at, updated_at, deleted_flag ) VALUE( #{storeName}, #{email}, #{tel}, #{postalCode}, #{address}, #{openingHours}, #{closedDays}, #{storeStatus}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 );
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m_stores.store_id, m_stores.store_name FROM m_books INNER JOIN store_books ON m_books.book_id = store_books.book_id INNER JOIN m_stores ON store_books.store_id = m_stores.store_id LEFT JOIN t_inventories ON m_books.book_id = t_inventories.book_id WHERE t_inventories.book_id IS NULL;
